settings.question: How long does delivery take across India and how can I track it?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 2-4 business days. Standard express delivery takes 5-7 business days across India. Once dispatched, you will receive real-time Speed Post tracking details via WhatsApp and SMS.

settings.question: How do I pick the right size for football jerseys?
settings.answer: Our jerseys follow athletic standard sizing (S to XXL). For fan editions, order your standard T-shirt size. For a relaxed fit or player-version tighter cuts, we recommend picking one size up. Check the size chart on any product page for exact chest measurements.

settings.question: What is the quality and material of 6YARD jerseys?
settings.answer: All our kits are master-quality player and fan editions crafted with 100% high-breathability Dri-FIT and AEROREADY fabric, durable heat-pressed or embroidered club crests, and authentic sponsor details.

settings.question: How do I track my order once it has been dispatched?
settings.answer: Once dispatched, you will receive a Speed Post tracking consignment number via SMS and email. You can also click 'Track Order' in our website header to monitor your shipment in real-time.

settings.question: What payment options are available on 6YARD?
settings.answer: We accept 100% secure online prepaid payments via Razorpay. You can pay instantly using UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED, BHIM), Debit & Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), and Net Banking. All online orders receive instant automatic payment verification and express Speed Post dispatch.

settings.question: How should I wash and care for my jerseys to make them last?
settings.answer: Machine wash inside out in cold water on a delicate cycle or gently hand wash. Never iron directly over heat-transferred badges or names, and always hang dry in the shade.
